stories.title: Buffalo teacher injured breaking up school fight; police recover knife
stories.summary: A Buffalo teacher was injured while trying to break up a school fight that spilled onto Chippewa Street. Police said they also recovered a knife at the scene.

stories.title: Buffalo school board rejects district school closure plan in 5-3-1 vote
stories.summary: A controversial plan to close and consolidate multiple Buffalo schools will not move forward after the Buffalo Board of Education voted it down Wednesday night.

stories.title: Unloaded gun found in student's bookbag at Buffalo high school after slipping past security screening system
stories.summary: Buffalo Public Schools and Buffalo Police are investigating after an unloaded firearm was discovered in a student's backpack.

stories.title: Cooking oil spill creates slippery conditions on New York State Thruway
stories.summary: A cooking oil spill from a 53-foot tanker prompted an emergency response near the Thruway and 290 on Wednesday.

stories.title: Parolee charged with murder after woman found dead in Allegany County
stories.summary: A 75-year-old man is facing a second-degree murder charge after authorities found a 57-year-old woman dead in Wellsville.

stories.title: New York demands answers from ICE on Batavia tent detention facility
stories.summary: Questions are mounting over a new ICE detention facility being built in Batavia.

stories.title: Hochul proposes nuclear expansion to power 5 million New York homes
stories.summary: Gov. Kathy Hochul says expanding nuclear energy will help keep New York's lights on and provide reliable power for both residents and businesses.

stories.title: 1970s-era Moog technology keeps Voyager 1 deep space probe in touch with Earth
stories.summary: Voyager 1 Launched in September 1977 with Moog-manufactured valves to keep spacecraft antenna directed at Earth from 16 billion miles away.

stories.title: NYS awards $1 million grant to developer for downtown Buffalo apartment project
stories.summary: Money will help Ciminelli Real Estate Corp in its effort to convert office building into living space.

stories.title: SNL skit hits close to home for many caregivers
stories.summary: The "Sister" skit has more than 5 million views online.

stories.title: Investigators work to figure out cause of Oliver Street fire in North Tonawanda
stories.summary: A North Tonawanda building housing two long-established businesses face uncertain future after two fires sparked on Wednesday.

stories.title: Thanksgiving on a budget: Where to find grocery store deals in Western New York
stories.summary: Thanksgiving is just around the corner, and with the cost of living on many shoppers’ minds, Western New York grocery stores are rolling out deals to help you save.
